method: anchored on the S-roundabout shared with the Valley masterplan (masterplan fitted to the placed homes, corr 0.32); scale from the strip length on the masterplan, checked by the roundabout diameter (29 m on both maps); then moved 100 m across the strip (toward the desert): the smallest move that takes every Kaia home off the existing homes and the mapped roads; it puts Kaia on the graded strip east of the boundary road seen in the satellite photo
why_rotation: Kaia map: its left end (roundabout, community centre) meets Elea, so the map turns 90 deg onto the masterplan strip
accuracy: provisional: Kaia is not built yet; position from the masterplan and the free land beside the community, estimated within about 30-50 m
